scheme_name: AICTE Idea Lab – Innovation & Design Excellence for Students
overview: The AICTE Idea Lab – Innovation & Design Excellence for Students is a scheme aimed at fostering innovation and design thinking among students by establishing Idea Labs in AICTE-approved institutions. These labs provide infrastructure and support for students to develop prototypes, work on innovative projects, and engage in hands-on learning experiences. The initiative encourages interdisciplinary collaboration and aims to strengthen the innovation ecosystem in technical education across India.
objectives: Establish Idea Labs in AICTE-approved institutions to promote innovation and design thinking
Provide students with access to prototyping facilities and technical mentorship
Encourage interdisciplinary project work and hands-on learning
Support the development of innovative products, services, and processes by students
Strengthen the innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem in technical education
eligibility: AICTE-approved institutions (such as engineering colleges, polytechnics, and universities) are eligible to apply for setting up an AICTE Idea Lab under this scheme.
benefits: Selected institutions receive financial support for setting up Idea Labs equipped with prototyping tools, design software, and innovation infrastructure. Students gain access to mentorship, workshops, and opportunities to participate in national-level innovation challenges and exhibitions. The labs foster creativity, problem-solving skills, and industry-academia collaboration.
financial_support: AICTE provides a one-time grant-in-aid to selected institutions for the establishment of Idea Labs. The financial support covers procurement of equipment, software, and initial setup costs. The exact quantum of support may vary based on the proposal and institutional requirements, subject to AICTE norms and guidelines.
application_process: 1. AICTE-approved institutions must submit a proposal online through the AICTE Idea Lab portal. 2. The proposal should include details about the institution, objectives, planned activities, budget, and expected outcomes. 3. Proposals are evaluated by an expert committee based on innovation potential, feasibility, and alignment with scheme goals. 4. Selected institutions receive approval and financial sanction from AICTE. 5. Upon approval, institutions proceed with setting up the Idea Lab as per the approved plan. 6. Institutions are required to submit utilization certificates and progress reports to AICTE after implementation.
required_documents: Proposal document outlining objectives, activities, and budget
Details of available space and infrastructure for the Idea Lab
Budget breakdown for equipment and setup
deadlines: Rolling basis — proposals are accepted throughout the year subject to availability of funds and AICTE announcements.
implementing_agency: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
caveats: Only AICTE-approved institutions are eligible to apply
Financial support is subject to availability of funds and AICTE budget allocations
Institutions must utilize the grant strictly for the approved purpose of setting up the Idea Lab
Progress reports and utilization certificates must be submitted post-implementation
